argv:
set -euo pipefail
RESULT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-ref-hf"
WORK=/tmp/ref3b1b_hf
rm -rf "$WORK" "$RESULT"; mkdir -p "$WORK" "$RESULT"; cd "$WORK"
python3 -m pip install -q --upgrade huggingface_hub yt-dlp Pillow
SRC='hf://buckets/chr1ce/VideodrData/3blue1brown/Integration and the fundamental theorem of calculus ｜ Chapter 8, Essence of calculus [rfG8ce4nNh0].mp4'
hf buckets cp "$SRC" source.mp4 >hf-download.log 2>&1
test -s source.mp4
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >server.log 2>&1 & SERVER=$!
trap 'kill $SERVER 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
sleep 1
yt-dlp --no-warnings -o via_ytdlp.mp4 http://127.0.0.1:8765/source.mp4 >yt-dlp.log 2>&1
kill $SERVER 2>/dev/null || true; trap - EXIT
test -s via_ytdlp.mp4
for spec in '00:08:40 ref_area.png' '00:09:50 ref_refine.png' '00:11:40 ref_ftc.png' '00:13:10 ref_geometry.png' '00:16:30 ref_recap.png'; do ts=${spec%% *}; out=${spec#* }; ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -ss "$ts" -i via_ytdlp.mp4 -frames:v 1 "$RESULT/$out"; done
python3 - <<'PYS'
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
import os
r=Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])/'agent-runtime/results/integral-3b1b-ref-hf'
fs=sorted(r.glob('ref_*.png')); cards=[]
for p in fs:
 im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB'); im.thumbnail((480,270)); cards.append((p.name,im.copy()))
sh=Image.new('RGB',(960,310*((len(cards)+1)//2)),'black'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
for i,(n,im) in enumerate(cards):
 x=(i%2)*480; y=(i//2)*310; sh.paste(im,(x,y)); d.text((x+8,y+275),n,fill='white')
sh.save(r/'contact_sheet.jpg',quality=92)
PYS
cp hf-download.log yt-dlp.log "$RESULT/"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of json via_ytdlp.mp4 > "$RESULT/reference_probe.json"
